title: Guru Tegh Bahadur Prepares for Sacrifice

blocks.text: The Guru reflected inwardly that the proper hour had now arrived.
When the destined time comes, anxiety has no place: the path of the world is never permanent, and what must be offered must be offered. (47–48)
Knowing this, the Satguru prepared himself for the sacrifice demanded by the age.
